content: Play size limits (support answer 9859372): base module 500MB, individual asset pack 1.5GB, cumulative modules+install-time packs 4GB, fast-follow/on-demand cumulative 30GB, 100 packs max. Downloads >200MB on mobile data need user consent (WAITING_FOR_WIFI, showConfirmationDialog). Install-time packs readable only via AssetManager (no file path); fast-follow/on-demand expanded to internal storage with getPackLocation().assetsPath(); packs invalidated on app update and on clear data; check every launch.
